description: Resolve a ticker, CIK, FinancialMD id or company name to the company FinancialMD covers, so later calls can use a stable identifier. Identifiers (ticker:AAPL, cik:320193, fmd_...) resolve directly and return the profile with meta.company showing what matched; a free-text name searches the directory and returns candidates with their ids, tickers and listings. Use this first when you are not sure of the ticker, or when a ticker is ambiguous across exchanges (ticker:AAPL.XNAS pins the venue). Issuers on EU and UK regulated markets that do not file with the SEC are covered too: they have no CIK, each candidate carries registry "esef" and an lei, and later calls take lei:<LEI> or the fmd_id. Statements and filings work for them, in the reporting currency; ownership, prices, events and segments answer not_covered.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 filter for name searches.

exchange.description: Optional exchange MIC filter for name searches (for example XNAS, XNYS).

limit.description: Maximum number of periods or items to return (default 10, at most 50).

query.description: Ticker, "cik:<n>", "lei:<LEI>", "fmd_<id>", or a company name such as "Apple".

name: company_lookup

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: For an identifier: the company profile. For a name: { items: [{ fmd_id, cik, name, country, registry, lei, reporting_template, status, primary_ticker, primary_mic, available_datasets }], next_cursor }.

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Find a company
